boardExam.title: The dental hygiene national board exam (NBDHE)
boardExam.description: The national written exam for dental hygienists is the National Board Dental Hygiene Examination (NBDHE), run by the Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations (JCNDE).
boardExam.heading: The national board exam for dental hygienists
intro: The national written exam is the National Board Dental Hygiene Examination (NBDHE). It is run by the Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations (JCNDE).

Every state requires dental hygienists to be licensed, and the requirements differ from state to state (US Bureau of Labor Statistics). For the clinical exam and the other rules in your state, see your state's page.
